description: SEC-011: advisories knowingly accepted for now. Every entry needs a reason and a review date; anything not listed here fails scripts/security/audit_dependencies.py. Review on or before the date, or when the blocking condition changes.

accepted.where: lab workspace, only through jsdom (apps/web tests)
accepted.reason: Test-only HTTP client inside jsdom; the tests make no requests to untrusted servers. Every patched undici (>=8.12.2) requires Node >=22.19, above the repository's declared engines (>=22.12), and refuses to load on older Node 22.
accepted.unblock: Raise package.json engines to node >=22.19 (team decision), then add an override undici@<8.12.2 -> ^8.12.2.

accepted.reason: Fixes are new major versions (transformers 5, sentence-transformers 5) that can change embedding output, and retrieval quality must be re-measured on the gold set before that (CLAUDE.md RAG policy). The service loads one fixed public model and never loads user-supplied model files.
accepted.unblock: Upgrade both, re-embed the corpus and re-run the retrieval gold set; accept only if recall does not regress.
